在瀏覽器開啟鍵盤顯示的網址，按畫面指示連接。輸入文字，按 Enter 傳送。: Open the keyboard’s address in your browser and follow the pairing instructions. Type your text, then press Enter to send.

在 App Store 下載 AirType。若系統詢問本地網絡權限，請選擇允許: Download AirType from the App Store. If asked for Local Network access, choose Allow.
前往「設定 → 一般 → 鍵盤 → 鍵盤 → 新增鍵盤」，選擇 AirType。: Go to Settings → General → Keyboard → Keyboards → Add New Keyboard and choose AirType. Open its keyboard settings and enable Allow Full Access so it can use the network.
在手機切換到 AirType: Switch to AirType on your phone
開啟一般文字輸入欄，長按地球圖示，選擇 AirType。打開 Web Acces: Open a normal text field, hold the globe key, and select AirType. Open Web Access and keep it visible.
在電腦打開連接網址: Open the connection address on your computer
電腦與手機須連接同一 Wi-Fi。在瀏覽器輸入鍵盤顯示的完整網址，包括連接埠。如: Your computer and phone must use the same Wi-Fi. Enter the keyboard’s complete address in your browser, including the port. If asked for a pairing code, enter the six digits shown on the keyboard.
打好文字，按 Enter: Type your message and press Enter
輸入文字後按 Enter 或傳送按鈕，文字會出現在手機目前的輸入欄。需要在草稿內: Type your text and press Enter or click Send. It appears in the phone’s active text field. Press Shift + Enter to add a line break to your draft.
網址或連接方式可能因 App 版本而異，請以鍵盤顯示的內容為準。部分 App、安: Addresses and connection steps may vary by app version. Follow what your keyboard shows. Some apps, secure password fields, and certain phone fields do not allow third-party keyboards.
電腦需要安裝程式嗎？: Do I need to install anything on my computer?
不需要。打開相容的網頁瀏覽器，輸入 AirType 鍵盤顯示的網址即可。電腦與: No. Open a compatible browser and enter the address shown on the AirType keyboard. Your computer and iPhone or iPad must be on the same Wi-Fi network.
可以打中文和 Emoji 嗎？: Can I type Chinese and emoji?
可以在電腦使用自己的輸入法輸入中文或其他語言，亦可以輸入 Emoji，再傳到手機: Yes. Use your computer’s input method to compose Chinese, other languages, or emoji, then send the text to your phone. AirType’s local keyboard uses an English QWERTY and symbol layout.
為甚麼要允許完整取用？: Why does AirType need Full Access?
iOS 的第三方鍵盤需要完整取用權，才可使用網絡連接。若系統另外詢問本地網絡權限: Third-party iOS keyboards need Full Access to use networking. If iOS also asks for Local Network access, allow it too. Use AirType only on Wi-Fi networks you trust.
網頁開不到，或連接中斷，怎麼辦？: What if the page won’t open or the connection drops?
先確認 AirType 的 Web Access 仍在手機上顯示，兩部裝置使用同: Keep Web Access visible, check that both devices use the same Wi-Fi, and verify the address and port. If the .local address fails, try the IP address shown on the keyboard. Guest Wi-Fi, client isolation, or a VPN may block the connection. If the page shows Reconnect, reopen the keyboard and click it.
這個網頁的示範會傳送我的文字嗎？: Does this website’s demo send my text anywhere?
不會。示範只在目前瀏覽器頁面內運作，重新整理就會重設。要實際傳送到手機，請下載: No. The demo runs only in this page and resets when you refresh. To send text to your phone, download AirType and open the local address shown on its keyboard.
示範文字只在這個網頁內處理，不會傳到 AirType 裝置或伺服器；重新整理頁面: Demo text is processed only in this page. It is not sent to an AirType device or server and is not kept after a refresh. This page does not include analytics, advertising trackers, or cookies.
Web Access 透過本地網絡把電腦輸入的文字傳到手機目前的輸入欄。請使用可: Web Access sends text over your local network to the active text field on your phone. Use trusted Wi-Fi. Local HTTP connections are unencrypted; do not send sensitive content over public or untrusted networks.
